chapter_seo_title: Little Stone Emperor Reborn: Plucking the Sun and Ten Millennia of Enlightenment
chapter_meta_description: The old Daoist merges with Little Stone Emperor's half-stone corpse, triggering a cataclysmic rebirth. He plucks the sun, creates nine new suns, and uses seven Stone-Man Kings for cultivation while Xiao Chen and Keke meditate for ten thousand years.
og_title: Little Stone Emperor's Rebirth: Sun Plucked and Ten Thousand Years of Insight
og_description: A legendary figure returns: Little Stone Emperor fuses his two bodies, plucks the Celestial Realm's sun, and opens a ten-thousand-year meditation for Xiao Chen and Keke.
twitter_title: Little Stone Emperor Reborn: Sun Plucked, World Shaken
twitter_description: Little Stone Emperor completes his rebirth, plucks the sun, and uses seven kings for cultivation. Xiao Chen and Keke gain ten millennia of enlightenment.
